headline: Rainy days ahead: Rain and thunderstorms to continue for 5 days across Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) warns of light to moderate rain, with heavy rainfall in some areas, across all eight divisions.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has issued a 120-hour forecast predicting a continued trend of rain and thunderstorms across various parts of the country for the next five days.
The weather pattern is driven by an active monsoon wind and a low-pressure system currently located over northeast Madhya Pradesh and adjoining areas.
For Wednesday, rain is expected in Rangpur, Mymensingh, Barishal, Chattogram, and Sylhet, with light to moderate showers in Rajshahi, Dhaka, and Khulna, and moderate to heavy rain in some locations.

On Thursday and Friday, the forecast predicts continued light to moderate rain and thunderstorms in Rangpur, Mymensingh, and Sylhet, with similar conditions in other divisions including Dhaka and Khulna.

By Saturday and Sunday, the rainy trend is expected to expand, with light to moderate rain and thunderstorms predicted for all eight divisions, potentially including moderate to heavy rainfall in some areas.
The BMD also noted that temperatures across the country will remain relatively stable or slightly decrease during this period.
In the last 24 hours, the maximum temperature was recorded at 36.2 degrees Celsius in Rajshahi, Jessore, and Chuadanga, while the lowest was 24.2 degrees Celsius in Sylhet.

headline_marked: Apple [[sets September 9 date for next iPhone launch]] event
headline: Apple sets September 9 date for next iPhone launch event
summary: The 'Surprise and Shine' event will be the first major occasion presided over by new CEO John Ternus.
details: Apple has confirmed its next product launch event will take place on September 9 at the Apple Park campus in Cupertino, California, under the tagline 'Surprise and Shine.'
The event marks a significant leadership transition, as it will be the first major occasion presided over by John Ternus, who officially succeeds Tim Cook as CEO on September 1.
Apple is expected to announce the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, though reports suggest these will be iterative upgrades rather than a major redesign.
Much of the industry's attention is focused on the potential reveal of a foldable iPhone, a category where Apple has yet to enter despite competition from other manufacturers.
Other expected announcements include the Apple Watch Series 12, a new Apple Watch Ultra, and additional smart-home products.
The company may also confirm release dates for its next generation of operating systems, including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate.
caption:
Apple's next big reveal is coming. Mark your calendars for September 9!

Apple has confirmed its next product launch event will take place on September 9 at the Apple Park campus in Cupertino, California, under the tagline 'Surprise and Shine.'

The event marks a significant leadership transition, as it will be the first major occasion presided over by John Ternus, who officially succeeds Tim Cook as CEO on September 1.

Apple is expected to announce the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, though reports suggest these will be iterative upgrades rather than a major redesign.

Much of the industry's attention is focused on the potential reveal of a foldable iPhone, a category where Apple has yet to enter despite competition from other manufacturers.

Other expected announcements include the Apple Watch Series 12, a new Apple Watch Ultra, and additional smart-home products.

The company may also confirm release dates for its next generation of operating systems, including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate.
